description: This Java class acts as a command handler for updating working days in the application. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands of type 'WORKINGDAYS' with action 'UPDATE', and delegates the update operation to the WorkingDaysWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateWorkingDaysCommandHandler
classes.description: Spring service class implementing the command handler for updating working days, annotated with command type 'WORKINGDAYS' and 'UPDATE', delegating the processing to a service layer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JsonCommand and invokes the update method on the working days service.
